requirements.statement: The repository shall include a .spec/AGENTS.md that gives local operating guidance for agents working inside the .spec workspace.
The repository shall include a .spec/decisions/README.md that explains when durable ADRs belong in the workspace.
The repository shall include a .spec/README.md that explains purpose, layout, and workflow.
When planning and verification run, the workspace shall generate .spec/state.json containing indexed subjects, indexed decisions, and verification state.
UnifiedUi.Adapters.Coordinator shall detect platforms, select renderers, render on one or many platforms, and coordinate state or signal routing across those platforms.
Adapter event modules shall normalize native terminal, desktop, and web events into consistent Jido.Signal values and payload shapes.
Terminal, desktop, and web renderers shall implement the shared renderer contract for render, update, and destroy operations using adapter state structures.
Adapter security helpers shall validate event actions, enforce payload limits, sanitize string inputs, and redact sensitive fields before signals are emitted.
Adapter support modules shall provide reusable renderer state, tree traversal, element lookup, and style collection helpers for all platforms.
Application modules and public APIs shall provide docs, and the selected doctest surface shall execute successfully.
The shipped custom widget example shall remain consistent with the extension guidance and continue compiling as an executable example.
Markdown links and anchors inside the guide set shall resolve to existing files and headings.
Elixir code examples in guides shall compile against the current library surface.
The repository shall ship current guides for getting started, DSL usage, layouts, widgets, styling, signals, extensions, platform adapters, dashboard tutorial, and troubleshooting.
DSL verification shall reject duplicate ids, invalid required attributes, invalid label references, invalid signal handler formats, invalid style references, and invalid state references.
The DSL shall support state declarations with atom keys and resolve runtime state references for content and boolean widget attributes.
UnifiedUi.Info shall expose compiled widgets, layouts, styles, and standard signals for DSL modules and DSL state maps.
Modules using UnifiedUi.Dsl shall compile nested UI declarations into a generated view/1 function and support nested blocks and comprehensions.
The DSL shall expose standard signal names and allow atom, tuple, and MFA signal handlers on supported entities.
The DSL shall support inline styles, named styles, and theme-aware style resolution for rendered entities.
The repository shall ship a custom widget example that matches the documented extension path.
The repository shall define UnifiedUi package metadata, documentation extras, and a public version helper.
The package overview shall describe UnifiedUi as a Spark-based multi-platform UI DSL targeting terminal, desktop, and web renderers.
The repository shall include CI, release, issue, and pull request automation files that codify contribution and validation workflow.
The component runtime shall batch burst signals in order and avoid rebuild work when updates leave component state unchanged.
UnifiedUi.Agent shall start components under supervision, address them by component id, stop them, and expose current state, IUR, and render results.
UnifiedUi.ElmArchitecture shall define init, update, and view callbacks for atom-key state maps and IUR output.
The runtime shall support persisted-state startup and the production-readiness recovery patterns currently covered by integration tests, including hot reload and runtime extension lifecycle flows.
UnifiedUi.Signals and UnifiedUi.SignalBus shall create standard signals, validate signal types, and deliver signals through component topics or PubSub topics.

mix unified_ui.gen.screen, mix unified_ui.gen.widget, and mix unified_ui.gen.extension shall generate modules and optional tests, and the screen generator shall update a supervisor file when requested.

mix unified_ui.format, mix unified_ui.test, mix unified_ui.bench, and mix unified_ui.perf.check shall delegate to the underlying formatter, test runner, and benchmark scripts while preserving their supported pass-through options.
mix unified_ui.preview shall render module previews for supported platform selections and mix unified_ui.stats shall report project structure statistics.
mix unified_ui.new shall scaffold a new project with application files, configuration, formatter setup, a starter screen, and starter tests.
Shipped UnifiedUi Mix tasks shall provide shortdoc and moduledoc entries.
The current implementation shall include advanced input, container, specialized, monitoring, and advanced layout widgets that compile and render across adapters.
The current implementation shall support basic widgets and core layouts, preserving nested tree structure and metadata through IUR translation.
UnifiedUi.IUR.Builder shall translate authored DSL entities into the corresponding UnifiedIUR or UnifiedUi widget structs while skipping non-render entities.
The current implementation shall support data visualization widgets and tabular widgets with their current value, sorting, and selection metadata.
The current implementation shall support navigation and feedback widgets including menus, tabs, tree views, dialogs, alerts, and toasts.

given: platform-native input events from the terminal, desktop, and web adapters
then: the resulting signals share a consistent type and payload shape and pass through the security pipeline
when: the adapters normalize and route those events

given: a single IUR tree and the currently supported platforms
then: each selected platform returns renderer state according to the shared contract
when: the coordinator renders on one, many, or all renderers

given: a module that uses UnifiedUi.Dsl with nested entities and declared state
runtime state passed to the generated view
then: view/1 returns an IUR tree built from the authored entities
runtime-bound values are resolved into the rendered output
when: the module is compiled and view/1 is called

given: a DSL module with duplicate ids or invalid references
then: compilation fails with a DSL validation error
the current IUR and render results can be queried by component id
when: a signal is delivered to the component

given: persisted or upgraded component state and runtime-managed component code
then: the runtime preserves the recovered state shape and continues processing signals
when: the component restarts or code is reloaded

given: a destination path for a new UnifiedUi application
then: the scaffolded project contains application, config, screen, and test files

given: an existing project and a screen or extension module name
then: the generated modules are written to disk and preview renders for the selected platform
when: the generator tasks and preview task run

given: authored UI using navigation, feedback, input, container, specialized, monitoring, and advanced layout widgets
then: the widgets retain their current metadata and render successfully on the supported platforms
when: the UI is rendered across the current adapters

given: authored DSL containing nested layouts, text, buttons, data visualization widgets, and tables
then: the resulting tree preserves hierarchy, ids, styles, and widget metadata
when: the DSL is built into IUR

meta.summary: Shared renderer behaviour plus terminal, desktop, and web adapters coordinated through common state, security, and routing helpers.
Guide set, API docs, example coverage, and cross-reference integrity for UnifiedUi documentation.
Compile-time DSL for authoring UI modules, dynamic bindings, styles, signals, and introspection.
Published package identity, repository automation, and shipped example surfaces for UnifiedUi.
ElmArchitecture behaviour, component runtime, signal helpers, and PubSub-backed signal delivery.
Canonical workspace contract for authored specs and generated Spec Led state.
Project, screen, widget, extension, preview, formatting, test, benchmark, performance, and statistics tasks shipped by UnifiedUi.
Implemented widget/layout surface and the builder that translates authored DSL into UnifiedIUR trees.
